datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 per current official dataset record (article publication rights are a separate artifact)
datasets.clinical_annotation_provenance: Original publication reports two calibrated dentists and third-dentist adjudication; source reference, no new SONRI clinician sign-off.
datasets.sharing_provenance: Original publication reports anonymization and written consent/assent for open sharing under AKUH ERC#2024-9433-29648.

source_test_reproduction.selection: Entire intersection of original benchmark-test COCO-referenced images with pinned Daath test filenames; no score-based selection.
source_test_reproduction.private_location: Operator temporary directory outside repository; mode0700 folder and0600 images. No image bytes committed.
source_test_reproduction.selected_member_integrity: ZIP CRC32 verified; per-image SHA256 frozen in manifest; original archive MD5 retained from record only.

blockers: Daath checkpoint trained on same source dataset: source-test reproduction is not external validation.
Patient identifiers are inferred from source filename regex; no documentary patient linkage or complete training patient manifest.303 training images fail that regex.
No full train/test exact/near-duplicate pixel audit or blinded SONRI clinician re-review.
Original COCO labels, LabelMe labels, YOLO indices and checkpoint class-name contract require cross-format adjudication.
No verified negative-image reference cohort in the selected17records.
No confidence threshold/model selection or clinical acceptance criteria approved by authorized professionals.
No artifact-tied Roboflow project/version/immutable annotation manifest, class order or modality.
Generic RF-DETR repository datasets or class counts cannot identify this custom checkpoint training reference.
Need owner-supplied secure exact export and annotation schema; no secret should be included in public evidence.
